messages:
maya: Quick sync — OrchBridge x LangChain/LlamaIndex pilot kickoff. Partner wants a minimal onramp: connector SDK, marketplace listing, SI enablement docs. Can we list owners and ship date targets?

sam: @maya we should lock the connector API contract first. I can own the schema and SDK stub. ETA 2w for a v0.

liam: I'll scope the quickstart and sample app for DevEx. Need examples for both gateway and orchestrator flows. Will try to reuse repo from flowforge demo.

jess: For marketplace listing we'll need: short description (30-40 chars), 3 screenshots, pricing tier, and a deployable helm/chart. Nina from GTM can shepherd assets.

nina: on it. I'll draft the copy this afternoon. Also ask partner for logos + preferred co-announcement window (2-week lead).

maya: checklist for team:
- [ ] Contracted connector API
- [ ] SDK + sample app
- [ ] Helm chart / marketplace bundle
- [ ] SI enablement doc + runbook
- [ ] Legal/PR signoff

liam: Quick note — for orchestration we need to confirm session/kv cache semantics. If OrchBridge uses stateless handlers we'll need the 'reply_to' token.

sam: good call. Adding snippet for the expected proto:
```json
{
 "connector_version": "v0.1",
 "supports_stream": true,
 "session_semantics": "kv-cache-compatible"
}
```

jess: Ops question: any hardware partner constraints? partner mentioned quantized models on A100 gen3 — pinging infra.

maya: @rc-deploy-bot can you check Dedicated capacity availability in eu-west-1 for pilot date 2024-08-05? :calendar:

rc-deploy-bot: Deploy check started. Reserved pools available: 2x T4, 1x A100. No Dedicated A100 gen3 capacity in eu-west-1 for that date. Suggest eu-central-1 or delayed window.

nina: If we can't get gen3 in eu-west, partner prefers eu-central. I'll coordinate.

maya: Owned by: sam (connector), liam (devex), jess (marketplace), nina (gtd). Target alpha demo: 2024-08-12. Can everyone ack?

sam: ack

liam: ack

jess: ack

nina: ack

maya: sweet. Follow-ups: sam to post API PR, liam to open example repo, jess to start marketplace draft. We'll sync Tue 9am PT. :thumbsup:
